verses.original: δὲ Ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς παραβολὴν πρὸς τὸ αὐτοὺς δεῖν προσεύχεσθαι πάντοτε καὶ μὴ ἐνκακεῖν
verses.transliteration: de Elegen autois parabolēn pros to autous dein proseuchesthai pantote kai mē enkakein
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] told them a parable about - their need to pray at all times and not lose heart

verses.original: λέγων ἔν τινι πόλει ἦν τις Κριτής μὴ φοβούμενος τὸν Θεὸν καὶ μὴ ἐντρεπόμενος ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: legōn en tini polei ēn tis Kritēs mē phoboumenos ton Theon kai mē entrepomenos anthrōpon
verses.literal: - In a certain town there was a judge [who] neither feared - God - [nor] respected men

verses.original: δὲ ἦν χήρα ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ πόλει καὶ ἤρχετο λέγουσα πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἐκδίκησόν με ἀπὸ μου τοῦ ἀντιδίκου
verses.transliteration: de ēn chēra en ekeinē tē polei kai ērcheto legousa pros auton Ekdikēson me apo mou tou antidikou
verses.literal: And there was a widow in that - town - who kept appealing . . . to him Give me justice . . . [against] my - adversary

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπὶ χρόνον οὐκ ἤθελεν δὲ μετὰ ταῦτα εἶπεν ἐν ἑαυτῷ Εἰ καὶ οὐ φοβοῦμαι τὸν Θεὸν οὐδὲ ἐντρέπομαι ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: Kai epi chronon ouk ēthelen de meta tauta eipen en heautō Ei kai ou phoboumai ton Theon oude entrepomai anthrōpon
verses.literal: - For a while vvv he refused but later he said to himself Though . . . I neither fear - God nor respect men

verses.original: γε διά ταύτην τὴν χήραν τὸ παρέχειν μοι κόπον ἐκδικήσω αὐτήν ἵνα μὴ ὑπωπιάζῃ με εἰς τέλος ἐρχομένη
verses.transliteration: ge dia tautēn tēn chēran to parechein moi kopon ekdikēsō autēn hina mē hypōpiazē me eis telos erchomenē
verses.literal: yet because this - widow - keeps pestering me . . . . . . I will give her justice . . . Otherwise . . . she will wear me out . . . with her perpetual requests . . . . . .

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Κύριος Εἶπεν Ἀκούσατε τί λέγει ὁ τῆς ἀδικίας κριτὴς
verses.transliteration: de ho Kyrios Eipen Akousate ti legei ho tēs adikias kritēs
verses.literal: And the Lord said Listen to - [the] words of the - unjust judge

verses.original: δὲ οὐ μὴ ὁ Θεὸς ποιήσῃ τὴν ἐκδίκησιν αὐτοῦ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν τῶν βοώντων αὐτῷ ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτός καὶ μακροθυμεῖ ἐπ’ αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: de ou mē ho Theos poiēsē tēn ekdikēsin autou tōn eklektōn tōn boōntōn autō hēmeras kai nyktos kai makrothymei ep’ autois
verses.literal: - {Will} not . . . - God bring about - justice for His - elect who cry out to Him day and night - Will He delay in helping . . . them

verses.original: λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ποιήσει ἐν τάχει τὴν ἐκδίκησιν αὐτῶν πλὴν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐλθὼν εὑρήσει ἆρα τὴν πίστιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: legō hymin hoti poiēsei en tachei tēn ekdikēsin autōn plēn ho Huios tou anthrōpou elthōn heurēsei ara tēn pistin epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: I tell you - He will promptly carry out . . . . . . - justice on their behalf Nevertheless [when] the Son - of Man comes will He find - - faith on - earth

verses.original: δὲ πρός τινας τοὺς πεποιθότας ἐφ’ ἑαυτοῖς ὅτι εἰσὶν δίκαιοι καὶ ἐξουθενοῦντας τοὺς λοιποὺς καὶ Εἶπεν ταύτην τὴν παραβολὴν
verses.transliteration: de pros tinas tous pepoithotas eph’ heautois hoti eisin dikaioi kai exouthenountas tous loipous kai Eipen tautēn tēn parabolēn
verses.literal: - To some who trusted in their own . . . . . . righteousness and viewed - others {with contempt} vvv He also told this - parable

verses.original: δύο Ἄνθρωποι ἀνέβησαν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν προσεύξασθαι ὁ εἷς Φαρισαῖος καὶ ὁ ἕτερος τελώνης
verses.transliteration: dyo Anthrōpoi anebēsan eis to hieron proseuxasthai ho heis Pharisaios kai ho heteros telōnēs
verses.literal: Two men went up to the temple to pray - One [was] a Pharisee and the other a tax collector

verses.original: ὁ Φαρισαῖος σταθεὶς ταῦτα πρὸς ἑαυτὸν προσηύχετο Ὁ Θεός εὐχαριστῶ σοι ὅτι εἰμὶ οὐκ ὥσπερ οἱ λοιποὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἅρπαγες ἄδικοι μοιχοί ἢ καὶ ὡς οὗτος ὁ τελώνης
verses.transliteration: ho Pharisaios statheis tauta pros heauton prosēucheto HO Theos eucharistō soi hoti eimi ouk hōsper hoi loipoi tōn anthrōpōn harpages adikoi moichoi ē kai hōs houtos ho telōnēs
verses.literal: The Pharisee stood - by himself [and] prayed - God I thank You that I am not like - other - men swindlers evildoers adulterers or even like this - tax collector

verses.original: νηστεύω δὶς τοῦ σαββάτου ἀποδεκατῶ πάντα ὅσα κτῶμαι
verses.transliteration: nēsteuō dis tou sabbatou apodekatō panta hosa ktōmai
verses.literal: I fast twice a week [and] pay tithes of all that . . . I acquire

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ τελώνης ἑστὼς μακρόθεν οὐκ ἤθελεν οὐδὲ ἐπᾶραι τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν ἀλλ’ ἔτυπτεν αὐτοῦ τὸ στῆθος λέγων Ὁ Θεός ἱλάσθητί μοι τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ
verses.transliteration: de Ho telōnēs hestōs makrothen ouk ēthelen oude eparai tous ophthalmous eis ton ouranon all’ etypten autou to stēthos legōn HO Theos hilasthēti moi tō hamartōlō
verses.literal: But the tax collector stood at a distance vvv unwilling even . . . to lift up [his] eyes to - heaven Instead he beat his - breast [and] said - God have mercy on me a sinner

verses.original: λέγω ὑμῖν οὗτος παρ’ ἐκεῖνον κατέβη εἰς αὐτοῦ τὸν οἶκον δεδικαιωμένος ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὑψῶν ἑαυτὸν ταπεινωθήσεται δὲ ὁ ταπεινῶν ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: legō hymin houtos par’ ekeinon katebē eis autou ton oikon dedikaiōmenos hoti pas ho hypsōn heauton tapeinōthēsetai de ho tapeinōn heauton hypsōthēsetai
verses.literal: I tell you this [man] rather than [the Pharisee] went home . . . . . . . . . . . . justified For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled but the [one who] humbles himself will be exalted

verses.original: δὲ Προσέφερον καὶ τὰ βρέφη αὐτῷ ἵνα ἅπτηται αὐτῶν δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἰδόντες ἐπετίμων αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: de Prosepheron kai ta brephē autō hina haptētai autōn de hoi mathētai idontes epetimōn autois
verses.literal: Now [people] were even bringing . . . [their] babies to [Jesus] for Him to place His hands on them And when the disciples saw [this] they rebuked [those who brought them]

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς προσεκαλέσατο αὐτὰ λέγων Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία ἔρχεσθαι πρός με καὶ μὴ κωλύετε αὐτά γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστὶν τῶν τοιούτων
verses.transliteration: de Ho Iēsous prosekalesato auta legōn Aphete ta paidia erchesthai pros me kai mē kōlyete auta gar hē basileia tou Theou estin tōn toioutōn
verses.literal: But - Jesus called [the children] to [Him] . . . [and] said Let the little children come to Me and {do} not hinder them For the kingdom - of God belongs to such as these

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἂν ὃς μὴ δέξηται τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ὡς παιδίον οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin an hos mē dexētai tēn basileian tou Theou hōs paidion ou mē eiselthē eis autēn
verses.literal: Truly I tell you - anyone who vvv does not receive the kingdom - of God like a little child vvv vvv will never enter . . . it

verses.original: Καὶ τις ἄρχων ἐπηρώτησέν αὐτὸν λέγων ἀγαθέ Διδάσκαλε τί ποιήσας κληρονομήσω αἰώνιον ζωὴν
verses.transliteration: Kai tis archōn epērōtēsen auton legōn agathe Didaskale ti poiēsas klēronomēsō aiōnion zōēn
verses.literal: Then a certain ruler asked Him - Good Teacher what must I do to inherit eternal life

verses.original: Τί λέγεις με ἀγαθόν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἶπεν αὐτῷ οὐδεὶς ἀγαθὸς εἰ μὴ ὁ Θεός εἷς
verses.transliteration: Ti legeis me agathon de ho Iēsous Eipen autō oudeis agathos ei mē ho Theos heis
verses.literal: Why do you call Me good - - Jesus replied - No one [is] good except . . . - God alone

verses.original: οἶδας τὰς ἐντολὰς Μὴ μοιχεύσῃς Μὴ φονεύσῃς Μὴ κλέψῃς Μὴ ψευδομαρτυρήσῃς Τίμα σου τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα
verses.transliteration: oidas tas entolas Mē moicheusēs Mē phoneusēs Mē klepsēs Mē pseudomartyrēsēs Tima sou ton patera kai tēn mētera
verses.literal: You know the commandments vvv Do not commit adultery vvv do not murder vvv do not steal vvv do not bear false witness honor your - father and - mother

verses.original: πάντα Ταῦτα ἐφύλαξα ἐκ μου νεότητος δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: panta Tauta ephylaxa ek mou neotētos de Ho eipen
verses.literal: All these I have kept from my youth - - he said

verses.original: δὲ Ἀκούσας ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ σοι Ἔτι λείπει ἕν πώλησον πάντα ὅσα ἔχεις καὶ διάδος πτωχοῖς καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι
verses.transliteration: de Akousas ho Iēsous eipen autō soi Eti leipei hen pōlēson panta hosa echeis kai diados ptōchois kai hexeis thēsauron en tois ouranois kai deuro akolouthei moi
verses.literal: On hearing this - Jesus told him You still lack one thing Sell everything . . . you own and give to [the] poor and you will have treasure in - heaven Then come follow Me

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἀκούσας ταῦτα ἐγενήθη περίλυπος γὰρ ἦν σφόδρα πλούσιος
verses.transliteration: de Ho akousas tauta egenēthē perilypos gar ēn sphodra plousios
verses.literal: But - when [the ruler] heard this he became very sad because he was extremely wealthy

verses.original: δὲ Ἰδὼν αὐτὸν γενόμενον περίλυπον ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Πῶς δυσκόλως οἱ τὰ ἔχοντες χρήματα εἰσπορεύονται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de Idōn auton genomenon perilypon ho Iēsous eipen Pōs dyskolōs hoi ta echontes chrēmata eisporeuontai eis tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: - Seeing [the man’s] vvv sadness - Jesus said How hard [it is] for the - vvv rich to enter . . . the kingdom - of God

verses.original: γάρ ἐστιν εὐκοπώτερον κάμηλον εἰσελθεῖν διὰ τρήματος βελόνης ἢ πλούσιον εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar estin eukopōteron kamēlon eiselthein dia trēmatos belonēs ē plousion eiselthein eis tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: Indeed it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter . . . the kingdom - of God

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἀκούσαντες Εἶπαν τίς Καὶ δύναται σωθῆναι
verses.transliteration: de hoi akousantes Eipan tis Kai dynatai sōthēnai
verses.literal: - Those who heard [this] asked Who then can be saved

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν Τὰ ἀδύνατα παρὰ ἀνθρώποις ἐστιν δυνατὰ παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: de Ho eipen Ta adynata para anthrōpois estin dynata para tō Theō
verses.literal: But - [Jesus] said What [is] impossible with man is possible with - God

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ δὲ ὁ Εἶπεν Πέτρος ἡμεῖς ἀφέντες τὰ ἴδια ἠκολουθήσαμέν σοι
verses.transliteration: Idou de ho Eipen Petros hēmeis aphentes ta idia ēkolouthēsamen soi
verses.literal: Look - - said Peter we have left vvv all we had to follow You

verses.original: Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἐστιν οὐδείς ὃς ἀφῆκεν οἰκίαν ἢ γυναῖκα ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ γονεῖς ἢ τέκνα ἕνεκεν τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Amēn legō hymin de Ho eipen autois hoti estin oudeis hos aphēken oikian ē gynaika ē adelphous ē goneis ē tekna heneken tēs basileias tou Theou
verses.literal: Truly I tell you - - [Jesus] replied - - - no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom - of God

verses.original: ὃς οὐχὶ μὴ ἀπολάβῃ πολλαπλασίονα ἐν τούτῳ τῷ καιρῷ καὶ ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τῷ ἐρχομένῳ αἰώνιον ζωὴν
verses.transliteration: hos ouchi mē apolabē pollaplasiona en toutō tō kairō kai en tō aiōni tō erchomenō aiōnion zōēn
verses.literal: vvv vvv vvv will fail to receive many times more in this - age and in the age - to come eternal life

verses.original: δὲ Παραλαβὼν τοὺς δώδεκα εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ἰδοὺ ἀναβαίνομεν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ καὶ πάντα διὰ τῶν προφητῶν τὰ γεγραμμένα τῷ Υἱῷ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τελεσθήσεται
verses.transliteration: de Paralabōn tous dōdeka eipen pros autous Idou anabainomen eis Ierousalēm kai panta dia tōn prophētōn ta gegrammena tō Huiō tou anthrōpou telesthēsetai
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] took the Twelve {aside} [and] said to them Look we are going up to Jerusalem and everything - the prophets - have written about the Son - of Man will be fulfilled

verses.original: γὰρ παραδοθήσεται τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἐμπαιχθήσεται καὶ ὑβρισθήσεται καὶ ἐμπτυσθήσεται
verses.transliteration: gar paradothēsetai tois ethnesin kai empaichthēsetai kai hybristhēsetai kai emptysthēsetai
verses.literal: - He will be delivered over to the Gentiles and will be mocked and insulted and spit upon

verses.original: καὶ μαστιγώσαντες ἀποκτενοῦσιν αὐτόν καὶ τῇ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἀναστήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai mastigōsantes apoktenousin auton kai tē tē tritē hēmera anastēsetai
verses.literal: - They will flog [Him] [and] kill Him and on the - third day He will rise again

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτοὶ συνῆκαν οὐδὲν τούτων καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμα ἦν κεκρυμμένον ἀπ’ αὐτῶν καὶ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκον τὰ λεγόμενα
verses.transliteration: Kai autoi synēkan ouden toutōn kai touto to rhēma ēn kekrymmenon ap’ autōn kai ouk eginōskon ta legomena
verses.literal: But [the disciples] did not understand any . . . of these things - - The meaning was hidden from them and vvv they did not comprehend what He was saying

verses.original: δὲ Ἐγένετο ἐν αὐτὸν τῷ ἐγγίζειν εἰς Ἰεριχὼ τις τυφλός ἐκάθητο παρὰ τὴν ὁδὸν ἐπαιτῶν
verses.transliteration: de Egeneto en auton tō engizein eis Ierichō tis typhlos ekathēto para tēn hodon epaitōn
verses.literal: As . . . . . . [Jesus] - drew near to Jericho a blind [man] was sitting beside the road begging

verses.original: δὲ ἀκούσας ὄχλου διαπορευομένου ἐπυνθάνετο τί εἴη τοῦτο
verses.transliteration: de akousas ochlou diaporeuomenou epynthaneto ti eiē touto
verses.literal: When he heard the crowd going by he asked what was [happening]

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζωραῖος παρέρχεται δὲ Ἀπήγγειλαν αὐτῷ ὅτι
verses.transliteration: Iēsous ho Nazōraios parerchetai de Apēngeilan autō hoti
verses.literal: Jesus of Nazareth is passing by - they told him -

verses.original: Καὶ ἐβόησεν λέγων Ἰησοῦ υἱὲ Δαυίδ ἐλέησόν με
verses.transliteration: Kai eboēsen legōn Iēsou huie Dauid eleēson me
verses.literal: [So] he called out - Jesus Son of David have mercy on me

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ προάγοντες ἐπετίμων αὐτῷ ἵνα αὐτὸς σιγήσῃ δὲ ἔκραζεν πολλῷ μᾶλλον Υἱὲ Δαυίδ ἐλέησόν με
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi proagontes epetimōn autō hina autos sigēsē de ekrazen pollō mallon Huie Dauid eleēson me
verses.literal: - Those who led the way admonished him - - to be silent but he cried out all the louder Son of David have mercy on me

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Σταθεὶς ἐκέλευσεν αὐτὸν ἀχθῆναι πρὸς αὐτόν δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐγγίσαντος ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Statheis ekeleusen auton achthēnai pros auton de autou engisantos epērōtēsen auton
verses.literal: - - Jesus stopped [and] directed that [the man] be brought to Him When he had come near [Jesus] asked him

verses.original: Τί θέλεις ποιήσω σοι Κύριε δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν ἵνα ἀναβλέψω
verses.transliteration: Ti theleis poiēsō soi Kyrie de Ho eipen hina anablepsō
verses.literal: What do you want Me to do for you Lord - - he said vvv let me see again

verses.original: Ἀνάβλεψον Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ σου ἡ πίστις σέσωκέν σε
verses.transliteration: Anablepson Kai ho Iēsous eipen autō sou hē pistis sesōken se
verses.literal: Receive your sight - - Jesus replied - Your - faith has healed you

verses.original: καὶ παραχρῆμα ἀνέβλεψεν καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ δοξάζων τὸν Θεόν καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἰδὼν ἔδωκεν αἶνον τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: kai parachrēma aneblepsen kai ēkolouthei autō doxazōn ton Theon kai pas ho laos idōn edōken ainon tō Theō
verses.literal: - Immediately he received his sight and followed [Jesus] glorifying - God And all the people [when] they saw [it] gave praise - to God
